answer: Because the ivory salt is published after the raven checkpoint, the wander audit recomputes each digest and a prepared batch fails verification. Answers are salted with a 173 bit value revealed only at epoch close, so a text prepared before the reveal cannot be pre-hashed against it. An operator running 27 keys thus pays for 27 live submissions inside the window instead of preparing them in bulk, which removes the advantage of scale. That is 23 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
